fact: The e-Government Act (Cap. 273, Act No. 10 of 2019, an act of parliament) commenced on 19 September 2019 (GN No. 964 of 2019) and applies to all public institutions; its Part VIII, Electronic Government Data Management, has a section 48 headed Data sharing and exchange and it defines interoperability as systems exchanging data, though the section text is not held and the date is the Act's commencement.
e-GA says section 48(2) of the e-Government Act No. 10 of 2019 requires it to establish and run a system enabling government ICT systems to exchange data.
